title: Have Lumi test your app while you watch

retention.hook: 0-3s: a finding appears in the Lumi sidebar over the live phone: a button that does nothing, found by Lumi.
retention.promise: by 9s: Lumi has tested your app and you have replayed one problem; no AI account, no code.

openLoops.question: How do you know a fix worked?

retention.payoff: replay (78s) then seed and Save as test (100s)
retention.series: Tutorial season; no recap. Trailer: link to the shipvo run video.

scenes.narration: Your app is on a phone, and something is wrong. A button does nothing. You did not find it. Lumi did, while you watched.
By the end, Lumi has tested your app, and you have replayed one problem. You need no A I account, and you write no code.
scenes.caption: By the end, Lumi has tested your app, and you have replayed one problem. You need no AI account, and you write no code.

scenes.narration: Open a terminal in your app folder. Type npx shipvo lumi, and press Enter. Shipvo builds a web copy of your app. For an iPhone, add ios. Android and iOS work the same way.
Your browser opens. The phone is on the left. Lumi's sidebar is on the right. Findings starts at zero. Now, give Lumi a job.
Type, test my app, and press Enter. Lumi taps through your app, from the start screen. A caption names each step, like, Tapping Checkout. The sidebar lists every action.

Now look at Findings. Each one is something Lumi reported. A button that does nothing. A screen that stays blank. A network call that fails. Each problem is listed once. Coverage shows how many screens and controls Lumi tried.
Here is the part that matters. Press Replay next to a finding. The phone repeats the steps that led to it. You watch the problem happen again, with your own eyes.
Want a harder test? Type, try checkout with bad input. Lumi runs the same path with invalid values. A finding here means your app accepted what it should refuse.

Fixed it? Prove it. Stop Lumi with Control C. Start it again with dash dash seed 1. The same seed gives the same walk, so you can check that the fix worked. And Save as test turns a finding into a test file that fails while the bug is there.
scenes.caption: Fixed it? Prove it. Stop Lumi with Ctrl+C. Start it again with --seed 1. The same seed gives the same walk, so you can check that the fix worked. And Save as test turns a finding into a test file that fails while the bug is there.

scenes.narration: That is it. Lumi tests your app while you watch. Try npx shipvo lumi in your app folder. The guide is at shipvo dot dev, slash learn.
scenes.caption: That is it. Lumi tests your app while you watch. Try npx shipvo lumi in your app folder. The guide is at shipvo.dev/learn.
